posts.title: Tonight's Movies: Rocky (1976) and I Play Rocky (2026)
posts.description: November 21st is the 50th anniversary of the New York premiere of ROCKY (1976), one of the key films of my early teen years. I saw ROCKY a number of times in the late '70s -- enough that I still pretty much have the dialogue memorized.
